1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyalkylenimine and polyanion are present in a molar ratio such that the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle exhibits controlled release properties distinct from the individual components.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to stabilize the nanoparticle structure.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, wherein said crosslinker is present in a concentration that produces a nanoparticle with enhanced stability compared to uncrosslinked polyelectrolyte complexes.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 50 to 100 nm in diameter.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said nanoparticle exhibits controlled release kinetics.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, wherein said multivalent cation is present in an amount that modulates the release profile of the nanoparticle.

13) (Original) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1 wherein the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is formed with a polyalkylenimine of less than 1500 Da; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, wherein said polymer has a molecular weight greater than 100,000 Da.

26) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
